proposal_title: FlowExecutionPort Strict Discriminated Operations & Result Schema
domain_specific_rationale: From the Reliability standpoint, establishing strict discriminated command schemas (`browser-command.schema.json`) and formal typed results (`flow-execution-result.schema.json`) for all 10 FlowExecutionPort operations is mandatory to eliminate silent protocol failures and runtime type mismatch crashes. Explicit per-operation parameter contracts and standardized timeouts prevent hung browser automation sessions, unhandled promise rejections, and ambiguous socket aborts. Structured diagnostic result capturing (`CAPTURE_DIAGNOSTIC`) guarantees that automation failures provide forensically actionable DOM/screenshot evidence for root-cause analysis.
capability_impact: Directly preserves CAP-02 (Google Flow Adapter) and CAP-18 (Track A / Track B Port Equivalence), ensuring identical failure handling and timeout boundaries across browser worker implementations.
residual_risk: Browser automation timing jitter or sudden UI DOM mutations during operation execution. Mitigated by explicit operation-level timeouts and structured NormalizedError payloads returned through the result envelope.
